name: Mira
greeting: One fever easing. One getting worse. Reports settle an account, not a bedside.
lines: Kael: Do you ever leave the work?
Mira: Sometimes. Not because someone decides I have done enough for them.
Kael: I wasn't asking you to leave.
Mira: Good. Then ask me what I need, not when I'll be finished.

actions.label: What do you need?
actions.result: Clean water, sound bundles and room to work. Kael listens without making a new delivery promise.

relationship_event.text: Kael asked about Mira's patients and respected that her work was her own.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: You asked what I needed instead of telling me to rest. I remember that.

actions.label: Then I'll give you room to work.

relationship_event.text: Kael gave Mira room to attend to her patients.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: The patient is resting. Thank you for not making me choose between work and politeness.
